request: Deploy verified sources on existing AWS and deliver reproducible evidence and rollback guidance
title: Archive executed final AWS release and rollback records
purpose: Preserve verified selective builds, blue-green release and guarded cleanup procedures

files.purpose: Switches Caddy via an explicit container config path, verifies 13 public probes, tags active images and automatically restores prior routing on failure.
files.previous_behavior: Executed release helper existed on AWS and in task temporary files but not in repository release records.
files.new_behavior: Switches Caddy via an explicit container config path, verifies 13 public probes, tags active images and automatically restores prior routing on failure. Archived as a historical fixed-release procedure, not a general rerunnable deployment tool.
files.data_impact: Archiving does not alter operational data. Historical prepare read production DB for server-side backup and ran idempotent service import. Finalize stopped containers without removing DB storage.
files.access_control_impact: No app permission expansion. Environment secrets remain server-side; script never prints their values.
risks: Fixed historical release paths must be inspected before any reuse; scripts intentionally reject unexpected active state. Git may normalize text line endings while preserving Python code.
files.rollback: Use recorded previous Caddy candidate to reload prior routing and restart retained prior containers if needed. Keep all business data; do not overwrite DB with an old backup just to roll back app routing.
